description: OUT OF SERVICE ORDERS is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. The FMCSA New Entrant Safety Assurance Program out of service (OOS) data, consists of all entities that have received an OOS order from FMCSA. File is comma delimited. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 7 columns, among them LEGAL_NAME, OOS_REASON, STATUS, OOS_DATE, DBA_NAME, DOT_NUMBER. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
